subject.title: feat(webchat): reply-to a message with hydrated reply context

question: Should Control UI reply-to become a supported `chat.send.replyToId` Gateway contract that hydrates agent-visible reply context from session history?
rationale: The implementation is additive and follows the merged Discord metadata model, but it extends a public gateway schema and defines the user-visible semantics for WebChat replies.

options.title: Approve the shared reply contract
options.body: Treat the optional `replyToId` path as the supported WebChat reply mechanism once real-flow proof confirms its behavior.

options.title: Keep reply presentation-only
options.body: Retain the existing inline-quote behavior and avoid adding a gateway protocol field if maintainers do not want reply semantics in WebChat agent input.

recommendation.title: Approve the shared reply contract
recommendation.body: Treat the optional `replyToId` path as the supported WebChat reply mechanism once real-flow proof confirms its behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the merged reply-context precedent and the recent follow-up implementation work.
